title: Perimeter and Area of Combined Shapes
introduction: Explore perimeter and area of combined shapes using everyday examples.
definition: Split a combined shape into nonoverlapping rectangles, squares or triangles to calculate area. For perimeter, count the outside boundary only and omit shared edges.

examples.question: A 6×4 cm rectangle shares a complete 4 cm side with a 4×4 cm square.
